run_learned_simulator_demo: run the model demo script to test LearnedSimulator inference with random particle data
create_sample_random_position_sequence: create a mock particle position sequence tensor with random positions for 50 to 1000 particles
build_learned_simulator_model: build a LearnedSimulator graph network model with configurable latent size and message passing steps
predict_next_position: predict the next position for each particle using the LearnedSimulator model in single step inference mode
get_normalized_accelerations: get predicted and target normalized accelerations for training the learned physics simulator model
